question: Can a deterministic local mutation search around the first frozen-ladder reachable residual source produce another exact 3-CNF whose canonical R42 trajectory reaches a genuine residual fixpoint with zero accepted pivots under the full frozen R45A macro grammar?
reachability_contract: Mutations are applied to the original exact 3-CNF source, never directly to a residual core.
Every candidate is rerun through the frozen R42 controller from the mutated original formula.
A candidate counts as a residual only if R42 returns STALLED_FIXED_SUCCESSOR and the reconstructed terminal formula passes the full R47H genuine-fixpoint integrity checks.
Arbitrary non-reachable cores are scientifically inadmissible.

mutation_grammar.round_2_base: best surviving genuine residual from round 1 by frozen fitness; if none, no round 2

fitness.otherwise_primary: maximize canonical ordinal of first accepted pivot; later first acceptance is treated as closer to macro-dead
fitness.otherwise_secondary: maximize number of rejected bipolar pivots before first acceptance

macro_probe.policy: stop at first accepted pivot for fitness
macro_probe.macro_dead_candidate_requires_before_sea: rescan every bipolar pivot, preserve every R47H debt/repayment receipt, and independently replay every candidate

interpretation.counterexample_scope: A found macro-dead reachable residual refutes O4 for the current frozen macro grammar/policy on that state; it does not prove P!=NP.
interpretation.finite_non_discovery: Finite local search cannot prove O4 or SAT in P.
interpretation.best_survivor: If no target is found, preserve the best later-first-accept survivor as the next adversarial seed.
